title: Fix Puzzle 3d Play Dev
description: puzzle 3d play dev server fails with Babel duplicate declaration BoardStructuralDeleteReporter in framework playground react renderer.
summary: Fixed puzzle 3d play 504 Outdated Optimize Dep: root cause was clearing node_modules/.vite while an old Vite server still listened on 6013, plus non-strict port fallback to 6014. runViteBunxDev now skips cache clear when the target port is in use, logs a clear message, and passes --strictPort by default. Added lucide-react to puzzle 3d play optimizeDeps. Tests: repo/lib/js 19/19, @semio-tech/puzzle-3d-play vitest 14/14.
